BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Taxonomy II ● Kingdom Plantae (general characteristics of organisms in Divisions.

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Reproduction in Animals ● External fertilisation in animals ● Types of internal .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Reproduction in Animals ● External fertilisation in animals ● Types of internal .

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Reproduction in Animals 3.2 Growth and Development in Animals 3.3 Excretion and .

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Taxonomy I ● Meaning and significance of taxonomy ● Taxonomic units and nomencla? (1 mark)
